tagline: Pick a game and play. No account, and every game but one works offline.
draftBanner: Test version: word packs are drafts.

pannben.name: PANNBEN
pannben.desc: Phone on your forehead. Friends give clues.

imposter.name: Imposter
imposter.desc: Everyone knows the word. Except one.

charades.name: Charades
charades.desc: Act it out. No talking, no sounds.

samething.name: Don't say the same thing
samething.desc: A category, a countdown, then you both say something. Don't match!
samething.meta: 2 players · great on a big screen

hatt.name: Lapp i hatt
hatt.desc: Everyone adds words, then describe, one-word and act them out.
hatt.meta: 4+ players · on your own phones · needs internet

yourPacksDesc: Make a pack with your own words: inside jokes, family names, holiday themes.

levelHelp.easy: Everyday things, like cat, banana or school.

setup.ownLevel: Your own packs use every word, no levels.
setup.pannbenTip: Turn the phone sideways and hold it to your forehead, screen facing your friends.
setup.charadesTip: One person acts, everyone else guesses. Pass the phone after each turn.
setup.emptyPack: This pack has no words yet.

imposter.noPeeking: Make sure nobody else is looking.
imposter.imposterHint: The category is {cat}. Listen closely and blend in.
imposter.hideAndPass: Hide it and pass the phone
imposter.takeTurns: Take turns saying one word linked to the secret word. {name} starts.
imposter.talkItDesc: Whose word didn't quite fit? When you're ready, count to three and everyone points at the same time.
imposter.lastGuess: Before the word is shown, {name} gets one guess. Say it out loud!
imposter.guessedIt: Did the imposter guess it? Then everybody wins this one.
imposter.newWordHelp: New word keeps the same players.

charades.nextActorDesc: Only you look at the screen. Everyone else gets ready to guess.

pannben.howTo: Hold the phone sideways on your forehead, screen facing your friends. They give clues; you guess.
pannben.tiltHow: Tilt the phone down when you get it right, up to pass. Or tap the buttons.
pannben.motionNote: Your phone may ask to use motion. Say yes to play with tilting.
pannben.noMotion: Tilting isn't available, so use the buttons.

handOn: Hand the phone to the next player.

packs.title: Your packs
packs.intro: Saved only on this phone. Nobody else sees them.
packs.savedOnPhone: Saved only on this phone. Nobody else sees it.
packs.playIn: Works in all three games. In Imposter, the pack name is the imposter's hint.
packs.confirmDelete: Delete "{name}" and all its words? This can't be undone.
packs.needWords: Add at least 3 words to play with this pack.

samething.how: A category shows up, you get a moment to think, then it counts down from 3. On zero, you both say something from it out loud at the same time. Said the same thing? That's a point. Fewer points is better.
samething.keysHint: On a keyboard: Enter starts, ← same, → different.
samething.msg0: Not a single match. Total opposites!
samething.msgFew: Only a few matches. Pretty different minds!
samething.msgMany: You two think alike. That's kind of sweet.
samething.againHelp: Keep going: same players, no repeated categories. New players: categories shuffled from the start.

tv.tagline: On the TV, played with the remote.
tv.more: More TV games are on the way.
tv.remoteHint: Remote: OK starts · ◀ same · ▶ different · Back leaves
tv.phoneTip: On a TV? Open tv.ellenial.app in the TV's browser and play with the remote.

footer: Made by people, for people. Free, no ads, nothing tracked.

hatt.intro: Everyone plays on their own phone. Each person adds 3–5 words, then you take turns describing them to your team. Best with 4+ players. The game lives for up to 24 hours.
hatt.mixHelp: 10 extra words. Your own words are more fun!
hatt.netTip: This game needs internet to collect everyone's words. Words are deleted when the game ends, or after 24 hours.
hatt.invited: You've been invited to Lapp i hatt! Write your name to join.
hatt.wordsHelp: Add 3–5 words: someone you know, a place, a job, an action… Only you can see yours.
hatt.full5: 5 of 5 added. Remove one to change it.
hatt.needTwo: Waiting for more players. Tap Invite to send the link.
hatt.needBothTeams: Both teams need at least one player.
hatt.startsWhen: The game starts when the last person is ready.
hatt.closesIn: Game closes in about {n} h · words are deleted afterwards
hatt.carryNote: {name} had {n} seconds left, so they start this round with them.
hatt.skipAsk: Skip {name}'s turn? The next player takes over.
hatt.guessedOne: Your team has guessed 1 this turn
hatt.guessedMany: Your team has guessed {n} this turn
hatt.guessAloud: You're on this team: guess out loud!
hatt.shh: Shh, no guessing! Keep an eye out so nobody says the word.
hatt.updatesAfter: The score updates when the turn ends.
hatt.deleted: Your words have now been deleted.
hatt.shareText: Join our Lapp i hatt game! Code: {code}
hatt.copied: Link copied. Paste it to the others.
hatt.gone: That game has ended or expired. Start a new one!

r1.name: Describe with other words
r1.rule: Say anything except the word itself. No "rhymes with" and no spelling it.

r2.name: One word only
r2.rule: Give exactly one word as the clue. Same words as round 1, so think back!

r3.name: Charades
r3.rule: Act it out. No talking and no sounds.

r4.name: One sound
r4.rule: Make one sound. No words, no acting.

err.name: Write your name first.
err.nogame: We couldn't find that game. Check the code.
err.noplayer: This phone isn't in that game any more.
err.busy: Lots of games right now. Try again in a while.
err.net: No connection. Check your internet and try again.
